title: How TaxiMunshi works
steps: **Add your cars & clients** — add the cars you run and the companies you bill.
**Add trips (duties)** — record every duty: date, car, client, km and hours.
**Make the invoice** — pick a client and month. Their trips come in by themselves. Add toll, state tax and parking.
**Share & get paid** — download or share the PDF, then mark it paid when the money comes.
**Invoices are made from trips.** Add trips first — then the invoice fills itself.

title: Logging in for the first time
steps: Open the login link from your welcome email or WhatsApp message.
Enter your email and the temporary password exactly as sent. Copy-paste it to avoid typing mistakes.
You'll see **Set your own password**. Choose at least 8 characters, with at least 1 letter and 1 number. It must be different from the temporary password.
Click **Save & continue**. You'll land on your dashboard.
The temporary password works for 7 days. If it has expired, email hello@taximunshi.com for a new one.

title: Your dashboard at a glance
steps: Four numbers at the top: **Billed, {month}**, **Billed this year**, **Outstanding**, and **Clients and cars**.
A 12-month chart of how much you've billed each month.
**Recent invoices** — your last 5 invoices, with a **See all** link.
If your company is new, a setup checklist appears first — see guide A3.
The company name at the top shows which company you're working in (see guide A5 if you have more than one).

title: Finish your setup (recommended order)
steps: **Add your company details** — your GST and contact information (guide B1).
**Add your first client**, or import several from Excel (guides D1 and F1).
**Add your vehicles**, or import them (guides C1 and F1).
**Set rates for a client** — what you charge them per car type (guides E1–E2, or F1 to import).
**Add your first trip** (guide G1).
**Make your first invoice** (guide H1).
Steps 2–4 can all be done in one go with the Excel upload — see guide F1.

title: Use TaxiMunshi on your phone like an app
steps: Android (Chrome): open TaxiMunshi, then tap **Install** when prompted (or tap ⋮ → Install app).
iPhone (Safari): open TaxiMunshi, tap the Share icon, then **Add to Home Screen**.
The icon now opens TaxiMunshi like an app. You still need internet to use it.
**Bulk add trips** needs a wider screen and only works on a laptop or desktop — on a phone, use **Log trip** instead (guide G1).

title: Working with more than one company
steps: Click the company name at the top and choose a company from the list.
Everything you see — clients, trips, invoices — belongs only to the company you've selected.
Before building an invoice, check you're in the right company.

title: Company & GST details
steps: Go to **Settings → Company**.
Fill in your company name, address, phone numbers, account email and invoice email.
Add your **GSTIN** if you're GST registered.
Set your **state** carefully — it decides whether GST is charged as CGST+SGST or IGST on every invoice (see guide K1).
Click **Save**.
Changes apply to new invoices only. Invoices already issued keep the details they were issued with.

title: Logo and invoice branding
steps: Go to **Settings → Branding**.
Click **Upload logo**. PNG or JPG only, up to 2 MB — it's automatically resized to fit.
Choose how it appears on invoices: **Text only**, **Logo only**, or **Logo and text** (recommended).
Use **Replace logo** to change it later, or **Remove logo** to go back to text only.
Check the live preview on the page to see how your invoice header will look.

title: Set where your invoice numbers continue from
steps: Go to **Settings → Numbering**.
Optionally set a **Prefix**, e.g. KC/26-27/ — it appears in front of every invoice number.
Set **Next number** to the number after your last old invoice. If your last bill was 148, enter 149.
Click **Save**.
Do this once, before issuing your first invoice. Each issued number is used once and is never reused, even if an invoice is later undone.

title: Add a vehicle
steps: Go to **Vehicles** and click **Add vehicle**.
Enter the vehicle number (e.g. HR26AB1234) — it's formatted automatically as you type.
Choose the **Type** (Dzire, Sonet, Crysta, Innova, Ertiga, or Other).
Choose **Ownership**: Own, or Attached. If Attached, enter the vendor's name.
Leave **Active** on so it shows up when logging trips.
Click **Add vehicle**.

title: Edit or remove a vehicle
steps: Open the vehicle, make your changes, and click **Save changes**.
To remove one, use the **Delete** option and confirm.
If a vehicle is used in any trips, it can't be deleted — switch it to inactive instead if you've stopped using it, so your records stay correct.

title: Add a client
steps: Go to **Clients** and click **Add client**.
Enter the client's name as it should appear on invoices, their address, state, and GSTIN if they're registered.
Add a **Default contact** — the person, phone or email you deal with there.
Turn on **Reverse charge (RCM)** only if this client pays GST themselves under reverse charge (see guide K2).
Click **Save**.

title: Edit a client
steps: Open the client, make your changes, and click **Save**.
Changes apply to future invoices only — invoices you've already issued keep the details they were issued with.
If you change a client's state or RCM setting, double-check any draft invoices for them before issuing.

title: Remove a client
steps: Open the client and choose **Delete**.
This also deletes any rate cards and quotations linked to that client — make sure that's what you want first.
A client with trips or invoices against them can't be deleted.

title: What a rate card is
steps: A rate card is what you charge one client for one car type.
**Local**: a base rate for a package (e.g. 80 km / 8 hrs), plus extra km and extra hour charges, a night charge, and a driver allowance.
**Outstation**: a rate per km, plus a driver allowance.
**Packages**: a named, fixed-price trip, e.g. Airport drop or a round trip — enter a name and a fixed price.
Fill in only the sections you actually offer that client for that car type.

title: Create a rate card
steps: Go to **Rate cards → Add rate card**, or open a client and use **Add for this client**.
Choose the client and car type.
Fill in Local, Outstation and Package rates as needed (see guide E1).
Click **Save rates**.

title: Change rates
steps: Open the rate card, make your changes, and click **Save rates**.
Important: a rate change applies to **every invoice you build from now on** — even for older trips that were logged before the change but haven't been invoiced yet.
Invoices you've already issued are frozen and never change, no matter what you do to the rate card afterwards.
If you're about to change a client's rates, build and issue invoices for their outstanding trips first, so older work gets billed at the old rate.

title: Upload vehicles, clients and rate cards from Excel
steps: Go to **Bulk import**.
Click **Download template (.xlsx)**. It has sheets for Clients, Vehicles, Rate Cards, and a Notes sheet explaining each column.
Fill in one, two, or all three data sheets. Keep the column headings exactly as they are.
Save as .xlsx (not CSV), under 10 MB.
Click **Choose file**, pick your file, then **Upload and preview**.
Check the preview: rows with a problem are flagged with the reason next to them. Some typos, like state spellings, are corrected automatically and marked.
Click **Import {N} items** to save the clean rows (if some rows have errors, it shows as **Import {N} items (skip {M} errors)**).
Fix the flagged rows in your Excel file and upload again. Rows already imported won't be duplicated.

title: What happens to duplicates
steps: If your file has the same client or vehicle twice, it's flagged so you can check before importing.
A rate card that matches an existing client and car type is updated with the new rates from your file.

title: Common Excel errors and fixes
steps: **"State isn't a valid Indian state"**: use the full name, e.g. Haryana, Uttar Pradesh, Delhi — check the Notes sheet for the full list.
**"[Field] is required"**: every column marked required in the template needs a value for that row.
**"Client not found in your existing clients or in this upload's Clients sheet"** (Rate Cards sheet): the client name must exactly match one in the Clients sheet, or one already saved in TaxiMunshi.
Contact person, phone and email from the Clients sheet are combined into one **Default contact** field once imported — that's expected.
File won't upload at all: check it's .xlsx and under 10 MB. If it still fails, email it to hello@taximunshi.com and we'll help.

title: Your data is in old bills or a different format
steps: Email your old bills or spreadsheet to hello@taximunshi.com with your company name.
We'll help you get it into TaxiMunshi.

title: Log a trip
steps: Go to **Trips** and click **Log trip**.
Fill in the **Duty date** — the date the car went on duty. This decides which month's invoice the trip goes into. Add an end date too for multi-day trips.
Pick the client and car. Don't see one in the list? Use **+ Add new client** or **+ Add new vehicle** right at the bottom of the dropdown — no need to leave this screen.
Choose the rate plan — local package, outstation, or a named package.
Enter the kilometres and hours run (fields shown depend on the rate plan).
Add driver allowance or night charges if they apply.
Toll, parking and other charges aren't entered here — add them when you build the invoice instead.
Click **Log trip**. The amount is worked out automatically from the client's rate card.

title: Edit or delete a trip
steps: A trip can be edited or deleted freely until it's on an **issued** invoice.
Once a trip is on an issued invoice, it's locked — you'll see "On an invoice. Undo it first."
To change a locked trip: edit the invoice if it's unpaid (guide H4), or undo the invoice (guide H5).

title: Bulk add trips (laptop or desktop only)
steps: Go to **Trips → Bulk add**. This needs a wider screen — it isn't available on a phone.
Type trips row by row like a spreadsheet.
Your entries save automatically as you type — you can close the page and come back later without losing anything.
Click **Save** to add the completed rows. Rows with a problem are highlighted.
Bulk add covers local and outstation trips — use **Log trip** for named/fixed packages.

title: Why a trip doesn't appear when building an invoice
steps: There's no rate card for that client, car type and rate plan — this is the most common reason. Add or fix the rate card (guide E2) and it will appear.
It's already on another invoice.
You're building the invoice for a different client — the trip list only shows one client at a time.
You're in a different company — check the company name at the top (guide A5).
Note: the billing period you pick doesn't hide trips by date — every un-invoiced trip for that client shows, regardless of its date.

title: Build an invoice
steps: Go to **Invoices** and click **Build invoice**.
Choose the client and billing period.
All un-invoiced trips for that client are listed and ticked — untick any you don't want on this invoice.
Add extra charges if needed — toll, tax, or parking.
Check the preview: lines, GST, total and amount in words.
Click **Issue invoice** to give it the next invoice number, or **Save as draft** to come back to it later.
For a single trip, **Quick invoice** (next to Build invoice) logs the trip and issues its invoice in one step.

title: Download and share an invoice
steps: Open the invoice and click **Download** to save the PDF.
Click **Share** to send it straight from your phone or laptop's own share menu — WhatsApp, email, or wherever you choose.
If your browser doesn't support that, it downloads the PDF instead so you can attach it yourself.

title: Mark an invoice as paid or unpaid
steps: In the invoice list, open the **⋮** menu on the invoice and choose **Mark paid**.
Marked by mistake? Open **⋮** again and choose **Mark unpaid**.

title: Edit an invoice
steps: Open the **⋮** menu on the invoice and choose **Edit**.
You can change the date, billing period, trips and extra charges. The invoice number stays the same, and GST is recalculated.
**Draft**: opens straight away, no confirmation needed.
**Issued, unpaid**: you'll be asked to confirm first, since the client may already have a copy.
**Paid** or **Undone**: can't be edited. Mark it unpaid first, or undo it and issue a new one.
Viewers can't edit invoices.

title: Undo an invoice
steps: Use this when an issued invoice was wrong and shouldn't count.
In the invoice list, open **⋮** and choose **Undo invoice**, then confirm.
It stays on record marked **Undone** — its number is never reused while it's in this state.
Its trips become free to put on a new invoice.
To free up the number itself, delete the undone invoice (guide H6).
Let your client know the old invoice no longer counts, and send them the new one.

title: Delete an invoice
steps: Only **drafts** and already-**undone** invoices can be deleted.
Open **⋮** and choose **Delete draft** or **Delete invoice**.
Deleting an undone invoice frees its number so it can be used again. A draft's number was never reserved, so nothing else changes.
Issued or paid invoices can't be deleted — undo them first (guide H5).

title: Read your billing on the dashboard
steps: The chart on your dashboard shows how much you've billed each month.
Draft and undone invoices are left out — only issued (paid or unpaid) invoices count.
It shows one combined total per month, not split into paid and unpaid.

title: Create a quotation
steps: Go to **Quotations** and click **New quotation**.
Choose or add the client, then add rate lines — car type, package, price.
Save it, then click **Download** to send it to your client.

title: Edit a quotation
steps: Open the quotation, make your changes, and save — this works at any stage, even on one already marked accepted.
If you edit a quotation after accepting it, remember the rate cards it already created won't update automatically — check them too (guide E3).

title: Client accepted the quote
steps: Open the quotation and click **Accept & create rate cards**, then confirm.
Its rates are saved as a rate card for that client, ready for billing trips straight away.

title: How TaxiMunshi decides GST
steps: Client in the **same state** as your company → CGST 2.5% + SGST 2.5%.
Client in a **different state** → IGST 5%.
Client marked **Reverse charge (RCM)** → no GST on the invoice; the client accounts for it themselves.
GST is worked out automatically. Your part is keeping your company's state, each client's state, and the RCM setting correct.
This is general help on how TaxiMunshi calculates GST. For your tax filing, check with your CA.

title: When to use RCM
steps: Under reverse charge, the client — usually a registered business — pays the GST directly instead of you.
Turn on RCM for a client only if you've agreed this with them and your accountant confirms it applies.
If you're unsure, ask your CA. TaxiMunshi applies whatever you set on the client.

title: Correcting a GST mistake
steps: Fix the setting that's wrong — your company's state, the client's state, or the RCM tick.
**Unpaid invoice**: edit it (guide H4) — GST recalculates from the corrected settings automatically.
**Paid invoice**: mark it unpaid and edit, or undo it and issue a new one (guide H5).

title: Forgot password
steps: On the login page, click **Forgot password?** and enter your email.
Open the reset link from your email soon after requesting it (check Spam/Promotions if you don't see it) and set a new password.
This is also the way to change your password at any time — there's no separate "change password" setting, just request a reset whenever you want a new one.

title: "Too many attempts"
steps: After 5 wrong passwords, login pauses for that email for 15 minutes.
You can still use **Forgot password?** during that time.

title: Temporary password expired
steps: A temporary password works for 7 days from when it was issued.
If it's expired, email hello@taximunshi.com and we'll send you a new one.

title: Shared or office computers
steps: Always sign out when you're done on a shared computer: click **Sign out** in the sidebar (or the menu on mobile).

title: "Account paused"
steps: Your company's access has been paused. Your data is safe and unchanged — nothing is deleted.
Email hello@taximunshi.com to restore access.

title: The page isn't loading or looks broken
steps: Refresh the page.
Check your internet connection.
Try another browser — Chrome is recommended.
Still broken? Email us a screenshot and the error code, if one is shown.

title: I don't see a new feature or a change
steps: Refresh the page.
If you installed TaxiMunshi on your phone, close it fully and reopen it.

title: PDF won't download or open
steps: Allow downloads and pop-ups for TaxiMunshi in your browser settings.
On a phone, check your Downloads folder or notification bar.
Try again on Chrome.

title: I didn't receive an email from TaxiMunshi
steps: Check Spam or Promotions.
Add hello@taximunshi.com to your contacts.
Make sure the email address on your account is correct.

title: The total or amount in words looks wrong
steps: Check each trip's kilometres, hours and extra charges.
Check the rate card for that client and car type.
Check your GST settings (guide K1).
Still wrong? Email us the invoice number and a screenshot.

title: I can't see Edit, Bulk add, or some other option
steps: **Edit** is hidden for paid and undone invoices, and for Viewers.
**Bulk add trips** only works on a laptop or desktop, not a phone.
Some options need an Owner or Admin — ask your company owner.

title: I'm worried two invoices have the same number
steps: TaxiMunshi gives each issued invoice a unique number, one after another, so duplicates can't happen.
If you ever see what looks like a duplicate, email us right away and we'll look into it.

title: I closed the page while filling something in
steps: **Bulk add trips** saves your entries automatically as you type.
Other forms — adding a trip, client, vehicle, and so on — don't save until you click the **Save** button, so re-check before closing the page.

title: Who can see my data?
steps: Only people on your company's own team can see your clients, vehicles, trips and invoices.
Other companies using TaxiMunshi can't see anything of yours.

title: Can TaxiMunshi staff see my invoices?
steps: Our team can see your company name and account status.
We don't see your clients, trips, rate cards or invoices.

title: Can I delete my account?
steps: Email hello@taximunshi.com from your registered email address and we'll take care of it.
